reasoning_steps: Identify the trapezoids and pentagon formed by the division of the square.
Note that the trapezoids have equal areas, implying that the longer parallel side of each trapezoid is the same length.
Since the trapezoids are congruent, the longer parallel side of each trapezoid is half the length of the shorter parallel side.
The shorter parallel side of each trapezoid is the side of the square, which is 1.
Therefore, the longer parallel side of each trapezoid is half the length of the shorter parallel side, which is 0.5.
